Market today: The mood is clearly bearish for tech and chips. Nvidia's 'death cross' and leading a tech sell-off, coupled with the Fed's inflation warning, are the main drivers. This directly impacts your highly concentrated tech/chip portfolio.

Your holdings: Almost everything is in 'SELL' territory. SOXL (-86.35%), MUU (-75.37%), and SMCI (-47.44%) are particularly concerning, especially given your margin usage which amplifies these deep drawdowns. Your leveraged ETFs (PLTU, MSFU, MUU, SOXL, SPAL, METU) are decaying and hurting extra.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Nvidia's price action and any further Fed commentary. The VIX options activity suggests some traders are betting on a bounce, but the macro picture is still tough.

Bottom line: The tech/chip sector is under significant pressure; managing your deep losses and leveraged positions is critical right now.
plays: Trim SOXL: Your largest loser at -86.35% and a leveraged ETF. Consider trimming to reduce exposure to further decay and sector weakness.
Respect stops on SMCI and MUU: These are down -47.44% and -75.37% respectively. Given the tech sell-off, ensure you honor your stops at 37.3 for SMCI and 31.6 for MUU to prevent further deep losses.
No new buys today - hold and watch: The market sentiment is too bearish for new long positions in your core sectors, and no scanner setups have a strong enough catalyst to warrant a new buy.
